name: io.github.douglasdemaio/vtessera
description: Find vtessera agent offers, read agent cards, route an intent, and read signed attestations.

packageArguments.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read

environmentVariables.name: VTESSERA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read. Defaults to http://localhost:8080.

vtessera/draft.why: The hosted endpoint is real and verified: https://vtessera-mcp.fly.dev/mcp initializes and serves all seven read-only tools against the live marketplace. The image exists and carries the ownership label: ghcr.io/douglasdemaio/vtessera-mcp:0.1.0 was pushed and its config labels io.modelcontextprotocol.server.name to the name in this file. What remains is outside this repo's control: the package is still private, so the registry's anonymous pull that verifies the label cannot read it yet.
blockers: ghcr.io/douglasdemaio/vtessera-mcp is private. The registry verifies OCI ownership by pulling the image and reading the io.modelcontextprotocol.server.name annotation, which requires making the package public: package settings, Change visibility.
Submitting needs a GitHub OAuth token with repo scope, which is the publisher's to hold.
beforeSubmitting: Set version here to the same string as mcpserver.Version, which is what a client sees at initialize. A listing and a binary that disagree is worse than either alone.
Set fileSha256 if the digest is known.
vtessera/draft.schemaCheckedIn: server.schema.json is the published 2025-12-11 schema, fetched and stored so this file is validated without a network call.
